title: Who would you like to chat with?
intro: No lessons here. Find someone you click with and talk about life, travel, or anything unexpected.
clearRecentConfirm: Clear recent chat dates? Your saved shared topics will remain.
recentEmpty: People you've spoken with will appear here for easy follow-up.
noMatches: No matching friends. Try a different name or interest.
privacy: Only actual chat dates are recorded. Topic memory is on by default and can be disabled or cleared in Settings. Friends are fictional AI characters, not real users who are online.
disabled: Conversation memory is off. Turn it on in Settings → Memory.
disabledHint: Conversation memory is off. Enable it in Settings → Memory.
noTopics: No shared topics yet. They'll grow over time as you chat, or you can add your own.
clearTopicsConfirm: Delete all shared topics with this friend?
